moments.title: Glasgow Hosts Commonwealth Games
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are underway in Glasgow, Scotland, featuring around 3,000 athletes from 74 nations and territories until August 2nd.

angles.name: Opening Excitement
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are in full swing, bringing incredible athletes and a fantastic atmosphere to our city. What's been your highlight so far?

angles.name: Team England Medal Haul

angles.name: Global Sporting Spectacle
angles.copy: With 74 nations competing, the Glasgow Commonwealth Games are a global spectacle. Catch all the action and cheer on your favourites!
